manifest.name: dsh-theme-mist
manifest.description: DSH Go visual language as a hot-pluggable client theme for DeepSeek Harness — six accents, light/dark/system, zero DOM rewrite.

scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:palettes && pnpm check:tokens && pnpm check:pack

bundle.text:
# Theme bundle patch: inserts the client entry into the profile's plugin roster.
# Installed via `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <path-or-package>`; the bundle
# declares dsh.bundle in package.json so reconcile() puts it into `bundles`.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-theme-mist
      name: 'dsh-theme-mist'

readme.text:
**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md)

为 **DeepSeek Harness**（桌面端与 Web 端）打造的客户端视觉主题插件。

设计灵感源自 [DSH Go](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-Go)，将移动端参考设计的色彩、材质与圆角语言移植到桌面/Web 端，以**低饱和中性色、分层的玻璃与纸墨质感、0.5px 发丝描边、悬浮毛玻璃与右上角单点光晕**重塑界面质感。

浅色 · 雾蓝 · 玻璃侧栏
深色 · 雾蓝 · 玻璃侧栏
---

雾蓝
黛青
暮紫

松石
琥珀
石墨

- **六套配色 × 明暗三态**：支持「雾蓝、黛青、暮紫、松石、琥珀、石墨」六套配色，并与官方「浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统」无缝叠加；浅色采用微染冷白纸面，深色采用偏蓝的深石板色（不是纯黑），全部 12 种组合均通过 WCAG AA 对比度校验。
- **克制的强调色比例**：强调色仅用于主按钮、关键选中态与右上角柔和光晕，大面积背景与卡片依靠明度层级和发丝细线拉开空间感。
- **真实毛玻璃与双档侧栏材质**：底部输入区采用悬浮毛玻璃，滚动对话时消息从输入卡背后自然透出；左侧栏提供 **玻璃** 与 **平铺** 两种材质。
- **原生设置集成 & 零残留卸载**：直接嵌入官方「设置 → 通用设置」面板，无需手改配置文件；禁用或卸载后，所有令牌与样式表完整还原为官方默认外观。

---
打开桌面端左侧栏 **「插件」→「添加插件」**，输入 `dsh-theme-mist`。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-theme-mist
```

---

安装启用后，打开 **「设置 → 通用设置」**，即可看到新增的两项主题设置： | 设置项 | 选项 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | **配色** | `雾蓝` · `黛青` · `暮紫` · `松石` · `琥珀` · `石墨` | 点击色块即时切换。 | | **侧栏材质** | `玻璃`（默认） · `平铺` | **玻璃**：半透明抽屉底板配 0.5px 发丝描边与右侧大圆角；**平铺**：去除底板，让页面渐变与光晕直接贯穿三栏。 | 两种侧栏材质对比（同一配色）：

玻璃（默认）
平铺
---

- **桌面端**：进入 **「插件」** 页面，找到 **Mist 主题 (`dsh-theme-mist`)** 点击移除即可。
- **Web 端**：
  ```bash
  dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-theme-mist
  ```

---

```bash
pnpm install          # 安装依赖
pnpm build            # 构建 lib/index.js 与 lib/client.js
pnpm verify           # 运行全量检查（构建 + 类型检查 + 单元测试 + 配色/令牌/打包契约校验）
```

如需了解底层实现细节、令牌推导算法与端到端测试工具，可参阅仓库内文档：

- [架构设计 (`docs/architecture.md`)](docs/architecture.md)：插件加载链路、三层主题架构与清理契约
- [视觉规范 (`docs/visual-spec.md`)](docs/visual-spec.md)：OKLCH 色彩推导、对比度矩阵、页面渐变与光晕、四层玻璃材质配方
- [配色色阶表 (`docs/reference/palette-tables.md`)](docs/reference/palette-tables.md)：六套配色的浅色/深色完整色值表
- [工具集说明 (`tools/README.md`)](tools/README.md)：令牌生成脚本、双版本回归测试与预览图自动拍摄脚本
- [变更日志 (`CHANGELOG.md`)](CHANGELOG.md)：版本迭代记录

[简体中文](README.md) | **English**

A hot-pluggable client theme plugin for **DeepSeek Harness** (Desktop & Web).

Inspired by the visual language of [DSH Go](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-Go), Mist ports the mobile reference design's colour, material and corner-radius language to Desktop and Web, reshaping the interface with **low-saturation neutrals, layered glass and paper-and-ink surfaces, 0.5px hairline borders, frosted glass chrome, and a single corner accent glow**.

Light · Mist · glass sidebar
Dark · Mist · glass sidebar
---
Mist includes six curated accent palettes. The top-right ambient glow, primary action buttons, active indicators, and hue-tinted paper/night surfaces adapt automatically to the selected accent.

Mist
Teal
Dusk

Aqua
Amber
Slate

- **Six Accents × Light / Dark / System**: Seamlessly layers Mist, Teal, Dusk, Aqua, Amber, and Slate over the host's Light, Dark, and System appearance modes. Cool-white paper surfaces in light mode and a blue-shifted charcoal in dark mode (never pure black) pass WCAG AA contrast checks across all 12 combinations.
- **Restrained Accent Budget**: Saturated color is reserved strictly for primary actions, active selections, and the subtle top-right glow. Depth is defined through luminance steps and 0.5px hairlines.
- **Frosted Glass & Dual Sidebar Materials**: The floating composer bar blurs scrolling messages underneath in real time, while the left sidebar offers a one-click choice between **Glass** and **Flat**.
- **Native Settings Integration & Clean Teardown**: Integrates directly into **Settings → General**. Disabling or uninstalling the plugin restores every host token and stylesheet with zero DOM residue.
In the Desktop app, open **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter `dsh-theme-mist`.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-theme-mist
```

---

Once installed, open **Settings → General** to find the two new rows:

| Setting | Options | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Accent** | `Mist` · `Teal` · `Dusk` · `Aqua` · `Amber` · `Slate` | Switches instantly when you click a swatch. |
| **Sidebar material** | `Glass` (Default) · `Flat` | **Glass**: Translucent sheet with a 0.5px hairline border and 28px right corners. **Flat**: Removes the sidebar backing so the page gradient flows seamlessly across all columns. |

The two sidebar materials compared (same accent):

Glass (default)
Flat
---

- **Desktop App**: Open **Plugins**, locate **Mist theme (`dsh-theme-mist`)**, and click Remove.
- **Web**:
  ```bash
  dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-theme-mist
  ```

---

```bash
pnpm install          # Install dependencies
pnpm build            # Emit lib/index.js (Node) and lib/client.js (Browser)
pnpm verify           # Build + typecheck + unit tests + palette/token/pack contract checks
```

For architectural details, token derivation math, and end-to-end verification harnesses, see:

- [Architecture (`docs/architecture.md`)](docs/architecture.md) — Loader lifecycle, 3-layer theme model, and cleanup contract
- [Visual Specification (`docs/visual-spec.md`)](docs/visual-spec.md) — OKLCH derivation, contrast matrix, the page gradient and glow, and the four-tier glass recipes
- [Palette Tables (`docs/reference/palette-tables.md`)](docs/reference/palette-tables.md) — Complete generated light/dark token values for all six accents
- [Tooling Guide (`tools/README.md`)](tools/README.md) — Token generator, dual-version E2E scripts, and automated preview capture
- [Changelog (`CHANGELOG.md`)](CHANGELOG.md) — Release history
